text:
Maya R: FYI we ran an 8-bit bring-up on the new family and saw a small but consistent hit on longform summarization F1. opening thread to coordinate a targeted promptset + labeling sweep to investigate.
Alex M: how small? numbers pls.
Maya R: end-to-end rougeL dropped ~3.2 pts on the 2k+ token group, short summaries fine. repro on both fp16 baseline and int8 compiled kernel.
Alex M: ok. raw test run: `baseline fp16: 46.7 -> int8: 43.5 (longctx subset)` logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3487 — looks like attention kernel divergence on steps > 1024.
Ravi K: probably kernel selection fallback for >1k. the runtime picked the quantized streamed-attn kernel that has less numeric stability for long keys. can try `--kv-split-size=2048` or use the safer matmul path.
Maya R: thanks. can we do a quick smoke that toggles kv-split and also re-eval with `cache_prune=false`?
Alex M: yes. I can kick off 3 variants: kv-split=1024, 2048, and matmul-fallback. will attach perf+quality.
Sam S: from eval perspective we should also expand our golden checks — current golden examples skew short. propose +250 long-dialog/generation cases (2k-12k tokens) and 500 near-duplicates to stress de-dupe.
Jen L: labeling team can handle that batch but need a clean dedupe strategy first. last time we had overlap with the edge-anchor set and labelers reworked the same items twice.
Maya R: proposal: pipeline -> 1) generate candidate longform set from live corpus sampling (N=10k) 2) run fuzzyhash dedupe threshold 0.78 -> keep unique 3) sample 1.5k prioritized by entropy and length -> split 250 golden, 1k label queue, 250 reserve. thoughts?
Jen L: fine. need schema for label UI. what labels do you want for golden? binary accept/repair + severity tags?
Sam S: golden should be multi-rater: accept/partial/hallucinated, plus a small rubric field for hallucination type. we'll use majority vote (3 raters).
Ravi K: on the quant side we should also add a micro-canary: run a short 200-example throughput test with token-level debug to see where distribution deviates (KV norms, attention weights). I can instrument.
Alex M: timeline: I can run 3 kernels smoke today (1h) and push artifacts. Jen, can you accept a labeling job tomorrow EOD?
Jen L: yes. need the dedup script + sample manifest by 10:00 PDT.
Maya R: ops-bot can you schedule a label job and reserve a small GPU pool for the canary runs?
ops-bot: scheduled: label job `engml-longctx-2026-04-01` -> starts 2026-04-01T17:00Z; reserved GPUs: 1xA10 for 2 hours for canary. Ticket: #ML-9832
Maya R: perfect. action items: Alex run kernels + upload artifacts; Ravi add token-level instrumentation; Sam prepare golden rubric and sample split; Jen prep label UI and staffing; ops-bot reserved. will reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:
Alex M: uploading results to the run link when done.
Ravi K: instrumented patch ready, will run with `--debug-token-delta` and attach flame traces.
Sam S: rubric draft: short bullets, examples, and 3-tier severity. will post in thread before label run.
Jen L: will confirm staffing and queue size by 10:00 PDT.
Maya R: thanks everyone. if we see regression still after kernel change we may need to lock to safe matmul path for longctx by default until we fix numerics.
